# Legal SOP
This SOP dictates the behavior of legal oversight personnel, including the Magistrate and Internal Affairs Agent.
Legal personnel exist to ensure that Space Law, SOP, VTS guidelines, and proper procedure are followed. They are oversight and advisory roles, not replacement command staff.
Legal personnel are expected to remain neutral and professional. They may review legal procedure, request records, advise departments, and recommend corrective action when supported by evidence.
Legal personnel are still subject to Space Law, SOP, VTS guidelines, and server rules.
